A passionate computer enthusiast, programmer and CSE aspirant who has been fascinated by computers and electronics for as long as he can remember.

THE STORY

I didn't discover
computers recently.

Computers have always fascinated me. I love understanding how technology works, experimenting with software and turning ideas into something real.

I'm currently preparing myself for undergraduate study, with Computer Science and Engineering as my dream subject. I'm still learning every day — programming, Linux, cybersecurity, algorithms and modern computer technologies.

I believe being a developer isn't about knowing everything. It's about staying curious enough to keep learning.
